name: Aihara Natsumi
source: Natsumi is [url=https://vndb.org/c63689]Takuya[/url]'s spiteful step-sister. She has a very demanding and haughty type of personality and she often abuses Takuya. She works at a company and shouldn't be at home at all but since she is on her vacation time at the moment - she came back home just in time to find out that Takuya has transformed into [url=https://vndb.org/c63690]a girl[/url] again, the event all too familiar to her since [url=https://vndb.org/v43]last year[/url]. Unlucky Takuya will have to survive her abuse once again.
